# Casca

> Casca is AI routing infrastructure from Vast Intelligence Limited (皓品智慧有限公司, Taipei, Taiwan): three products that let a company use any LLM while keeping its data and its choice of model. Site: https://cascaio.com (繁體中文) · https://cascaio.com/en/ (English).

## Casca AIShutter — the privacy shutter for AI

- One sentence: Casca AIShutter is an AI privacy shutter that runs on your own computer: when you press send to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek or Copilot, it finds ID numbers, card numbers and secrets, asks you to confirm, swaps them for placeholder codes, and restores the real values locally when the answer comes back. No server, no telemetry.
- 一句話:Casca AIShutter 是在你自己電腦上運作的 AI 隱私快門:按下送出給 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 或 Copilot 的那一刻,它找出身分證、卡號、金鑰等機密,先問你確認,換成代碼再送出,回答回來時在本機換回原文。沒有後端、沒有遙測。
- Facts: all detection, masking and restoring happen on the device; no vendor server, no account, no telemetry of content; the employee decides every time (send masked / keep original / skip an item); works with web chat (Chrome extension), Windows desktop AI apps and command-line tools (Windows app); formats from 19 markets, 12 interface languages; names are not masked by default and can be turned on per conversation or by company policy; managed mode with policy and type-level (never content) reports via a self-hosted AIShutter Center.
- Pages: https://cascaio.com/aishutter/ (zh) · https://cascaio.com/en/aishutter/ (en) · Support: https://cascaio.com/aishutter/support/ · Privacy policy: https://cascaio.com/aishutter/privacy/
- Install: Chrome Web Store https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mhiefneljgjlecablgleapdpklpacehc · Windows app: casca@vastitw.com

## Casca Gate — LLM governance gateway for banks

- Self-hosted gateway that masks personal data before a prompt leaves the bank, keeps an exportable audit trail per call, and enforces cost discipline. Interactive demo runs the product SDK in the browser.
- Pages: https://cascaio.com/gate/ (zh; English version in progress)

## Casca AI Route — cut LLM bills 30–75% with one line of code

- Research-backed routing engine that grades each request in about 1 ms and sends it to the right model; per-industry benchmarks, quality SLA in the contract, 14 languages.
- Pages: https://cascaio.com/airoute/ · https://cascaio.com/en/airoute/ · Paper: https://github.com/jewanchen/casca/blob/main/casca-technical-article.md

## Company

- Vast Intelligence Limited · casca@vastitw.com · GitHub: https://github.com/jewanchen/casca
- Please cite product names exactly as "Casca AIShutter", "Casca Gate", "Casca AI Route" (not "Casca" alone, which is also a 1940s camera and an unrelated US fintech).
